style.format: Pop animation with a musical soundtrack; no voice-over required.
style.palette: Pale green, black and white with coral, sky-blue and yellow accents. No purple.
style.copy: Show only the active scene's localized title and body. Let the gestures and memes explain the feature.
style.sound: Music and short synchronized effects. Sound examples start only once the viewer has explicitly played the film.

scenes.visual: Three local cat, monkey and dog memes pop into view on the beat. They fold into sticker shapes around the Zapstick mark, then one opens into the mobile editor. No messaging-app availability claims.
Tap the large upload plus. Three compact media cards appear: a photo, a looping cat GIF and a video. Select the photo, then switch to the looping GIF; the live preview visibly animates.

Zoom into the link input. A short generic public-media URL is pasted using the paste/import control. A small loading pulse resolves into the same animated meme in the editor. Do not display a fake successful private link or invented account flow.

Add a short localized caption: 'Au boulot !' / 'Back to work!' / 'Bora trabalhar!'. Cycle through two font treatments and a contrasting text background. Drag the caption directly across the preview to the lower edge. The underlying cat animation keeps playing.

fr.title: La bonne réaction
fr.body: Pose ton émoji où tu veux.

scenes.visual: Choose a laughing emoji from the compact palette. Drag it with a visible finger-sized pointer from the center to an upper corner. Briefly enlarge it, then show the caption and emoji together over the moving meme.

fr.title: Change le décor
fr.body: Retire le fond. Choisis ta couleur.

en.title: Change the backdrop
en.body: Remove the background. Pick a color.

pt-BR.title: Mude o cenário
pt-BR.body: Remova o fundo. Escolha sua cor.

scenes.visual: Use a clearly separated subject so the cutout is readable. Wipe from the original background to a transparency checkerboard, then apply pale yellow and coral backgrounds. Keep the subject, caption and emoji visible; do not imply universal perfect cutouts.

fr.title: Le meilleur moment
fr.body: Choisis ton extrait. Garde le mouvement.

en.title: Keep the best moment
en.body: Trim the clip. Keep it moving.

pt-BR.title: Fique com o melhor momento
pt-BR.body: Escolha o trecho. Mantenha a animação.

scenes.visual: Open Animation. Reveal the video filmstrip and move its two trim handles to a short funny action. Loop that chosen moment twice in the persistent preview. Show a six-second total composition for the following audio demonstration, without suggesting a 120-second sticker export.

Use a video that actually contains audio. Open Sound and show Sound 1 already populated by its original soundtrack. A short keyboard-tap sound aligns with the working cat. Show the six-second ruler and a clear first audio block; keep the UI compact.

pt-BR.title: Dois sons, em sequência
pt-BR.body: O segundo vem depois do primeiro.

scenes.visual: Add an imported audio file to Sound 2. It appears immediately after Sound 1 by default, with the first block spanning 0–3 seconds and the second 3–6 seconds. Use contrasting blue and coral blocks with text labels. Shorten Sound 1 from three to two seconds and show Sound 2 following it automatically, then restore the three-second junction. Do not animate a required click on 'After sound 1' to obtain this default.

fr.title: Prends le passage à 5 s
fr.body: Le passage change. Sa place reste.

en.title: Start the excerpt at 5 s
en.body: Change the excerpt. Keep its place.

pt-BR.title: Comece o trecho em 5 s
pt-BR.body: Mude o trecho. Mantenha a posição.

scenes.visual: Select Sound 2. Enter 5 in its source-excerpt start field and keep the excerpt duration at three seconds. Show the source range 5–8 seconds, while its composition block stays at 3–6 seconds after Sound 1. Tap the excerpt-listen control, then briefly play the assembled mix. The source start and the timeline placement must be visibly distinct.

fr.title: Tout à sa place
fr.body: Crée tes collections. Glisse tes stickers.

en.title: Everything in its place
en.body: Make collections. Drag stickers into them.

scenes.visual: Save the result to the local collection. Create a small colored collection named 'Réactions' / 'Reactions' / 'Reações'. Drag the new sticker into it, then reorder two sticker cards. A press and release without displacement leaves the order unchanged. No additional help panels or account screens.

fr.title: C’est prêt
fr.body: GIF animé ou vidéo avec son.

en.title: Ready to go
en.body: Animated GIF or video with sound.

pt-BR.title: Prontinho
pt-BR.body: GIF animado ou vídeo com som.

scenes.visual: Present two simple export cards: a visibly looping animated GIF and a video marked with a sound icon. A download tap lands on the beat. Finish with the Zapstick mark and the finished captioned meme. The GIF has no audio; the video does. Do not show or promise conversion inside WhatsApp.
